_comment: Adapter file for 'Mientras tanto, en Santiago…'. Relatos never calls
Instagram at runtime: media referenced here is served from our own
/media/, so the page works whether or not Instagram is up and no
Populate 'items' by hand today. When the account is eligible for the
official Instagram Graph API, an ingestion script can write this same
file server-side and the frontend does not change.
alt        (required) alt text for the image
caption    short line shown under the thumbnail
permalink  original Instagram URL, optional — opens in a new context
href       internal target instead of permalink, e.g. /momentos/xx.html
draft      true to keep it out of the build
